title: Two same-wave attempts rewriting the same function's exit logic collide without git ever flagging it
body: 4mv and bot both rewrote how watch decides its exit code in the same wave; the merge machinery saw a conflict only where lines overlapped textually (exit.go, README), while watch.go merged cleanly-but-wrong, and only bot's tests at the integrated gate caught it. The cost was a resolve job, a person's settle (decision 13) and a re-dispatch. A claim-time touch check that flags two same-wave attempts editing the same function — not just the same lines — would have serialized them.
